decisions.reason: The rye country bread is part of the firm's core traditional bread range, and management has already defended it once, so it continues to justify the earlier commitment.
The gold-medal premium raisin stollen is the firm's publicly presented flagship, so dropping it is practically unthinkable.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established rye line, and with no sign of failure management sees no reason to reverse its decision to keep it.
The marzipan stollen supports the committed Christmas stollen direction alongside the flagship, so management keeps investing in it.
Having publicly announced the ancient grain bread as its newest masterpiece, management attributes any slow uptake to the time a new specialty needs and stays committed.
